notes.title: MindWorks Release
notes.content: Only 4 days left. MindWorks is out this Friday, September 4th, at 12:00 midnight (Pacific Standard Time). Stay up late Thursday and be one of the first to download this new type of VR experience. Don't forget that MindWorks will be available for 20% off the standard price for the first week after release. Take advantage and start creating and enjoying right away!
